items.t: Timing belt wear on an interference engine
items.note: Many shops do the water pump at the same time. If the belt already broke, bent valves can mean a much bigger head repair.

items.t: Front coil springs can rust and break (recall)
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer first.

items.t: Front lower control arm can shift or crack (recall)
items.note: Price is per side. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer about the recall first. An alignment is usually needed after.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace windshield wiper motor
items.note: Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer about the recall first.

items.t: Fuel tank can crack from vapor system vacuum (recall)
items.note: Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer about the recall first. Vapor system parts may also need replacing.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips from leaking solenoid seals (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission solenoid seals and refill fluid
items.note: Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer about the recall. If the clutches are already worn, a rebuild costs much more.

items.t: Automatic transmission failure
items.note: Some cases are fixed with a solenoid or fluid service. A used unit costs less than a remanufactured one.

items.t: Throttle may not close in extreme cold (recall)
items.job: Repair throttle cable and linkage per recall
items.note: Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer about the recall first.

items.t: Wiper linkage can come apart (recall)
items.note: Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer about the recall first.

items.t: Brake light switch failure (recalls)
items.note: Often free under Hyundai's brake light switch recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Airbag light from passenger seat sensor mat
items.note: Hyundai extended coverage on this sensor for many cars. Ask a dealer to check your VIN before paying.

items.t: Ignition coil misfires
items.note: Spark plugs are often replaced at the same time.

items.t: Dash power outlet can overheat (recall)
items.note: Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer about the recall first.

items.t: ABS module can short and start a fire (recall)
items.note: The recall fix is free and is often just a new fuse. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Oil consumption and engine knock
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured long block
items.note: Price is for a knocking engine. Oil use alone may only need a PCV check or ring repair. Used engines cost less.

items.t: Airbag light from occupant detection system
items.job: Replace passenger seat occupant detection sensor
items.note: Have the codes read first; a loose connector under the seat is sometimes the cause. Ask the dealer about open recalls.

items.t: Trunk latch can break (recall)
items.note: Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer about the recall first.

items.t: IVT check engine light from oil pressure sensor
items.note: Often covered by Hyundai's powertrain warranty for original owners. Ask the dealer about the bulletin first.

items.t: Front seat belt pretensioner may burst (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Steering column bolt may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten steering column bolt
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Brake master cylinder seal damage (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.
